newsitem.title: USA: News Corp names Mechanic head of Fox films.
newsitem.headline: News Corp names Mechanic head of Fox films.

text.p: Fox Filmed Entertainment, the movie studio wing of media giant News Corp Ltd, has named William Mechanic as its new chairman and chief executive officer overseeing all studio operations.
He replaces Peter Chernin, who was promoted to president and chief operating officer of News Corp in October.

Mechanic, who had been president and COO of the studio, will take control of worldwide feature film production, marketing and distribution as well as FoxVideo, Fox Music, Fox Interactive and all licensing and merchandising activity.
"There is no better executive in the business," Chernin said in a statement. "He has been my partner in every aspect of the studio for the past three years."

Mechanic joined Fox in 1993 as president and chief executive officer of 20th Century Fox, the company's film production division. During his tenure, Fox released the major hit, "Independence Day" along movies like "Mrs. Doubtfire", starring Robin Williams, and "Speed" which launched actors Keanu Reeves and Sandra Bullock to stardom.
He also helped form several new divisions at Fox. He came to Fox from Walt Disney Studios, where he was president of international distribution and worldwide video.
